answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the sonnet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the jetty of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nadir re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
